billingPage.faq1Q: How does the 14-day money-back guarantee work?
billingPage.faq1A: Every first-time subscription to a paid plan (Creator, Pro or Agency) includes an unconditional 14-day money-back guarantee. If Click isn't the right fit for you, email {{email}} within 14 days of your first charge for a 100% refund. No cancellation hoops, no retention calls.
billingPage.faq2Q: Who owns the copyright and commercial rights to my videos and digital twin assets?
billingPage.faq2A: You keep 100% exclusive intellectual property and commercial rights to all your raw footage, generated clips, scripts, voice notes and digital twin avatar outputs. Click claims no copyright or licensing royalties over your content.
billingPage.faq3Q: How do I cancel or change my subscription?
billingPage.faq3A: You can cancel or switch plans yourself at any time, in one click, from your Whop customer portal or your Click account settings. After you cancel, your plan stays fully active until the end of the billing period you've already paid for. We never charge early-termination fees.
billingPage.faq4Q: Are my private videos, audio notes or voice prints used to train public AI models?
billingPage.faq4A: Never. Click follows GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and Illinois BIPA (740 ILCS 14/). Your media, style profiles and voice data are kept in isolated, dedicated processing environments and are never added to public or foundation-model training data.
billingPage.faq5Q: Which payment methods and currencies are supported?
billingPage.faq5A: All payments are processed securely by Whop with bank-grade 256-bit TLS encryption. Whop accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay and local bank payments in 135+ currencies.
billingPage.faq6Q: Will I be charged overage fees if I go over my usage limits?
billingPage.faq6A: Never. Click has no surprise billing. When you reach your limit for video rendering, AI credits or scheduling, those features pause until your next billing period or until you choose to upgrade. You will never get an unexpected overage bill.
